purpose: FC-10 / KA-12 registry of every cross-repository document this package cites normatively, pinned by immutable commit SHA. A citation pinned to a branch silently re-targets when the other repository moves, so a statement that was true when written becomes a claim about a document that no longer says it. Verified offline by `npm run check:pins`; verified against the remote by `npm run check:pins -- --verify-remote`.

cloud/dochost-server.access_note: Comfy-Org/cloud is PRIVATE. `npm run check:pins -- --verify-remote` resolves this pin only with a token that has access; without one the GitHub API answers 404, which this gate treats as definitive evidence ABOUT THE PIN (exit 1) rather than about the request (exit 2). That classification was deliberately introduced by #66 and is right for a public repo; it mis-fires here. Read a 404 on this pin as 'no access', not 'pin broken', until the gate learns to tell them apart.
